lines: tres digne: eſtant vn autre Phrinondas, duquel Ariſto-
phanes parle, ou vn vray Syſiphe,
Syſiphus in terris, quo non aſtutior alter.
D'autant que la ſuppoſition eſtant ia deſcouuerte, il
ſçeut neantmoins ſi bien impoſer aux Iuges, voire en-
cor à ladite de Rols, de laquelle ſe diſoit touſiours ma
ri: que les Iuges le relaxerent en effect, par vn appoin
tement de contraires. Et la femme encor le receut pour
Martin Guerre ſon mari.
Et neantmoins le lendemain de
grand matin ledit Pierre Guerre, com-
procureur de ladite de Rols, accompa-
gné de ſes beaux fils, tous armez, le fit
conſtituer priſonnier, bien que pour lors
ni peuſt auoir nouuelles charges, & que
ladite de Rols n'euſt encor fait procu-
reur ledit Pierre Guerre à ces fins. car la
procure ne fut faite ce iour-la, iuſques
au ſoir apres veſpres, comme iceluy Pier
re Guerre meſme depuis a confeſſé.
Ceſtoit doncques vn faux procureur, car tel eſt ap
pellé en noſtre droict, non ſeulement celuy qui n'ha eu
iamais ni auant, ni apres charge de la perſonne, de
laquelle il ſe dit procureur {a}: ou bien qui d'aultresfois
l'ha euë reuoquee, comme il ſçauoit bien {b}. mais en
cor celuy qui a outrepaſſé les fins & bornes de ſa puiſ-
ſance, ou qui n'auoit point de charge au temps de l'exe-
cution {c}. voyre celuy qui auroit eſté bien & legitime-
ment conſtitué ſ'il ne ſçauoit point & neantmoins il fai-
ſoit les actes de procureut {d}. vray eſt qu'en ce fait,
Pierre Guerre du commencement, faux procureur, a

uncertain.text: ſoit les actes de procureut {d}. vray eſt qu'en ce fait,
uncertain.note: sic: 'procureut' — the final sort is a t (clear crossbar and curved foot) where 'procureur' is meant; wrong sort, transcribed as printed

uncertain.text: l'ha euë reuoquee, comme il ſçauoit bien {b}. mais en
uncertain.note: 'euë': the final e carries two marks (a round dot left, a slanted stroke right); read as a tréma, but 'eué' is possible

uncertain.text: D. de cõd. ca.
uncertain.note: the stop between 'cõd' and 'ca' is a faint low dot crossed by a paper fibre; could be read 'cõdica.' as one word

uncertain.text: dau. l. licet. C.
uncertain.note: 'dau.' — third letter is two minims joined below (u), no crossbar, so not 'dat.'; the abbreviation is not one I can resolve, reading given as printed

uncertain.text: l ſulſus. & il
uncertain.note: 'ſulſus' is not a Latin form I can resolve and there is no stop after the opening 'l'; glyphs read ſ-u-l-ſ-u-s, a period may be lost between 'ſul' and 'ſus'

uncertain.text: fur. la Glo &
uncertain.note: 'fur.' — f has a full crossbar and the third letter has an r shoulder; 'fuſ.' cannot be ruled out at this resolution

uncertain.text: tutor. l. iij. Ꝑ.
uncertain.note: numeral: three dots are visible but the middle minim is worn, so 'ij' is possible instead of 'iij'

uncertain.text: tutor. l. iij. Ꝑ.
uncertain.note: final sign is a capital P with a stroke through the descender, used here as the paragraph abbreviation before the § incipit 'ſed & ſi quidem'; transcribed Ꝑ (U+A750), could be intended as §

uncertain.text: l. quæro. D.
uncertain.note: 'quæro' — the ligature is inked heavily; a plain 'a' ('quaro') is just possible

uncertain.text: phanes parle, ou vn vray Syſiphe,
uncertain.note: the print sets 'v n' with a wide gap (spacing sort risen or loose); read as the single word 'vn' and closed up.

uncertain.text: reur ledit Pierre Guerre à ces fins. car la
uncertain.note: the mark after 'fins' sits slightly above the baseline; read as a period (no tail), could be a damaged comma or colon.

uncertain.text: procure ne fut faite ce iour-la, iuſques
uncertain.note: the first letter of 'fut' is damaged (curled top, crossbar faint); read as f, could be ſ ('ſut').

uncertain.text: iamais ni auant, ni apres charge de la perſonne, de
uncertain.note: the print sets 'ap res' with a gap inside the word; closed up as one word.

uncertain.text: cor celuy qui a outrepaſſé les fins & bornes de ſa puiſ-
uncertain.note: the line-end sign after 'puiſ' is a small dot-like mark, possibly a period rather than a hyphen; transcribed as the word-break sign '-'.

uncertain.text: ſance, ou qui n'auoit point de charge au temps de l'exe-
uncertain.note: 'point' is poorly printed (the n looks like 'a' or a damaged sort, 'poiat'); read as 'point'.

uncertain.text: ſoit les actes de procureut {d}. vray eſt qu'en ce fait,
uncertain.note: sic? the last letter of 'procureur' appears as a t ('procureut'); transcribed as printed; could be a worn r.

uncertain.text: ment conſtitué ſ'il ne ſçauoit point & neantmoins il fai-
uncertain.note: the print sets 'ſç auoit' with a gap and 'point&' tight; word division normalized.

uncertain.text: D. de cõd. ca.
uncertain.note: between 'cõd' and 'ca.' there is a small vertical mark, read as a period; could be a stray mark with no punctuation intended. The D is a swash italic capital.

uncertain.text: l ſulſus. & il
uncertain.note: no period visible after 'l'; 'ſulſus' as printed (expected 'falſus'), sic.
